title: Owner synchronization write contract v1 (implementation pending)

x-semantics.revisions: Server allocated; stale same-field changes return 409, never last-device-clock-wins
x-semantics.request_replay: Same request_id and body returns original result; changed body returns 409
x-semantics.deletion: Persistent tombstone; old devices cannot resurrect deleted records
x-semantics.finite_numbers: Reject NaN, Infinity and boolean numbers; preserve unknown null and genuine zero
x-semantics.portfolio_scope: fund_only; account target weights sum per fund; no implicit normalization
x-semantics.cost_aggregation: Share-weighted only when every relevant cost is known
x-semantics.valuation_coverage: Incomplete pricing never claims a complete portfolio denominator
x-semantics.manual_assets: Display separately from fund_only action weights
x-semantics.snapshots: Only confirmed revision creates immutable Holding/Policy/Decision versions
x-semantics.cloud_consent: Explicit enablement required before uploading personal data
x-semantics.history: Explicit import/export retention contract; never silently omitted
